round5-campaign.what: Round 5 differential-fuzz campaign for the M2 Phasing replica: the evidence behind 'hard:fuzz, all five surfaces, 0 divergences' after the full-state unmake comparison landed.
round5-campaign.whyAManifest: One artifact per seed is written by `hard:fuzz --out`; 26 of them are 26 near-identical 3 KB files whose only content is zeros. This manifest records their totals, their exact invocations and their provenance instead, and `lab/results/hard-ai-verify/fuzz.json` holds one full artifact (batch A's first seed) so the artifact SHAPE stays checked in.
round5-campaign.treeNote: Run from the round-5 working tree, NOT from the commit above: the changes under test (statesnap.ts, the full-state unmake comparison in differential.ts, the fuzz-loop divergence cap, the gitDirtyFiles provenance field) are uncommitted. Reproducing from the bare commit reproduces the OLD digest-only check.

batches.name: A
batches.command: for s in $(seq 300 319); do npx tsx lab/hard-ai/fuzz/run.ts --actions 250000 --arrival-cases 120 --cases 1500 --seed $s --no-repro --out <dir>/s$s.json; done

batches.name: C
batches.purpose: seeds that diverged in rounds 1-3, replaying their ORIGINAL walks (--resign-rate 0)
batches.command: for s in 7 14 15 38 104 145; do npx tsx lab/hard-ai/fuzz/run.ts --actions 250000 --arrival-cases 120 --cases 1500 --seed $s --resign-rate 0 --no-repro --out <dir>/s$s.json; done

round5-campaign.faultSensitivity: Every counter above is shown to be able to MOVE by tests/lab/fuzz-fault-injection.test.ts, which injects a fault per surface through a Replica subclass (lab-only `replica` option) or a vitest mock of tactics/prover.ts.
